Peko-Check Lv1See your Death Stranding 2 progress straight from your save. It is read in this browser, never uploaded and never changed.

How to read the orders. Done: delivered. In progress: accepted, not delivered yet. Available: you can take it at a terminal. Locked: not offered yet. Compare with… shows what changed between two saves, with a report you can copy, for example to send a test result (see How you can help).
Order and item names are the game's own English text, read from the game files with ShadelessFox's Odradek. Item icons: Tabler Icons (MIT) and our own drawings (see the third-party notices). Guide links go to Game8 or the Death Stranding Wiki. Source code, how to help and the roadmap: github.com/binsento-netizen/ds2-peko-check. Fan project, not affiliated with Kojima Productions, Sony Interactive Entertainment, hololive production or COVER Corporation.
